holm_adjustment.family: One-sided exact binomial tests against break-even payout 0.85
holm_adjustment.note: Holm controls family-wise error only for this declared test family. Tests are not independent because rolling horizons share overlapping outcomes, and the adjustment does not eliminate adaptive selection bias from the screening matrix.

comparison.holm_adjustment_limitations: Holm adjustment controls the listed family-wise comparisons only. Rolling-horizon outcomes are correlated, and the adjustment does not eliminate adaptive selection bias from the screening matrix.
comparison.holm_limitation: Holm adjustment controls family-wise error for pre-specified tests only; it does NOT eliminate adaptive selection bias from development trials.

limitation_notes.adaptive_selection_bias: Candidates were selected on the same development data used for ranking.
limitation_notes.multiple_comparisons: Many trials were compared; Holm does NOT eliminate adaptive selection bias.
limitation_notes.no_independent_evidence: No held-out independent or prospective confirmation is present.
limitation_notes.temporal_dependence: Rolling predictions overlap and must be treated as CORRELATED.

comparison.ranking_policy: Descending development OOS balanced accuracy (fallback directional accuracy), then non-overlapping accuracy, then simpler model family, then fewer features.

nested_evaluation.adaptive_selection_bias_note: Nested selection separates threshold/hyperparameter choice from each assessment fold, but it does not eliminate adaptive selection bias across the full matrix.
nested_evaluation.reason: Nested chronological selection on the best eligible finalist
